Hi Jordan — thanks for sending these over and for the clear details. We're glad to onboard SupplyCo.

What we need from you to create the vendor record and enable PO issuance:
1) Completed Redwood supplier form (attached) — includes tax ID, remit-to address, and primary billing contact.
2) W-9 (you already attached, perfect)
3) Bank details for ACH (routing + account) OR invoice remit instructions — we can accept either, but ACH speeds payment.
4) Any contractual exceptions (e.g., net-60 instead of net-30, special invoice instructions).

Notes on PO process:
- Once vendor record is created in our finance system, we can issue a standard PO within 1–3 business days.
- PO numbering uses the format RDW-YYYY-XXXXX; if SupplyCo requires a PO reference on your invoices, reply with the required field.
- For orders over $50k we need procurement approval and legal sign-off — otherwise it's handled by the finance intake queue.

I've attached our supplier form and a brief onboarding checklist spreadsheet with the fields we populate on our side. If it's helpful we can do a 20-minute handoff call early next week to walk through the form together.

Attachments: redwood_supplier_form.pdf; redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Thanks Mina — received and looks complete. Quick answers:
- Vendor creation: 2–3 business days after we receive the completed form + W-9. If you provide bank info now we can fast-track to 1 business day but it requires an ACH verification step (micro-deposits).
- Payment verification: We typically do micro-deposits for ACH on first-time vendors; you can alternatively bill via invoice and request ACH later.
- First PO issuance: Once the vendor record exists, we can issue a PO immediately (same day), subject to procurement approval thresholds. For amounts >= $50k expect an extra day for approvals.

Jordan — can you confirm if you prefer us to proceed with vendor creation without bank details (you will invoice) or if you want to provide ACH info now and confirm a contact to receive micro-deposit verification? If you want a short set-up call, I can block 15 minutes Mon at 10:30am PT.

Attachment: vendor-activation-sla.pdf
